requirement_description: Gross parental/family annual income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 from all sources.
failure_guidance: Applicants with family income exceeding ₹4,50,000 per annum are ineligible for Central Sector CSSS scholarship.

requirement_description: Student must have scored above the 80th percentile in the relevant stream in Class XII / +2 examination of respective Board.
failure_guidance: State board and CBSE/ICSE declare annual cut-off marks corresponding to the 80th percentile for Science, Commerce, and Humanities.

requirement_description: Student must not be receiving any other government scholarship or fee concession scheme concurrently.
failure_guidance: Students holding other central or state government scholarships must surrender one under DBT duplication guidelines.

requirement_description: The candidate must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) recognized by the Government of Karnataka.
failure_guidance: This specific scheme is restricted to Scheduled Caste students; OBC/ST/General students should apply under their respective departmental schemes.

requirement_description: Total parental/guardian annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
failure_guidance: A valid revenue department Income Certificate (e-Pramaan Patra with RD number) is required to verify income below ₹2.5 Lakhs.

requirement_description: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
failure_guidance: Students studying in Karnataka who are domiciled in other states must apply to their home state's post-matric scholarship portal.

requirement_description: The applicant must be a female student.
failure_guidance: The Pragati scheme is exclusively earmarked for meritorious girl students admitted to technical education.

requirement_description: Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
failure_guidance: Valid annual family income certificate issued by a Competent Revenue Authority not below the rank of Tehsildar is mandatory.

requirement_description: Candidate must be admitted to 1st year Degree technical program (or 2nd year through lateral entry) in an AICTE-approved institution.
failure_guidance: Only students enrolled in AICTE-approved degree level institutions are eligible.

requirement_description: Maximum of two girl children per family are eligible under the Pragati scheme.
failure_guidance: In families with more than two daughters, only up to two can receive the Pragati scholarship.

requirement_description: The farmer family must own cultivable agricultural landholding in their names as recorded in the official state land revenue records.
failure_guidance: Land title must be duly recorded in the state land database (Bhoomi in Karnataka, Bhulekh in UP, etc.) with verified e-KYC.

requirement_description: All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year are strictly excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.
failure_guidance: Farmer families where any member filed and paid income tax in the previous assessment year are legally excluded from PM-KISAN.

requirement_description: The applicant must be the recognized female head of the household (Yajamani) specified on the Karnataka Ration Card.
failure_guidance: If the ration card does not designate a woman as the family head (Yajamani), the family must update the designation via Ahara portal first.

requirement_description: The beneficiary must be a resident of Karnataka holding a valid state ration card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL).
failure_guidance: Applicants must possess an active Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies Department Ration Card.

requirement_description: Neither the female head of the family nor her husband should be an Income Tax payer or GST return filer.
failure_guidance: Households with income tax or GST filers are ineligible under the social welfare focus of Gruha Lakshmi.
